description: open-feature-dev push gate: in a repo that holds an open-feature-dev workspace, ask before git push, gh pr create, and glab mr create.

hooks.command: [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.open-feature-dev" ] && grep -qE '(git( +(-C|-c) +[^ ]+| +--?[A-Za-z][^ ]*)* +push|gh +pr +create|glab +mr +create)([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"open-feature-dev push gate: confirm this push or PR/MR command"}}'; true
